name: Nerawareta Gakuen - Closed Escape
original_name: 狙われた学園 CLOSED ESCAPE
source:
The school has no doors. The girls in it have no way out.
They are there just to be hunted.
You are the anomaly, the monster that stalks them.
Follow the innocent girls through darkened, empty halls, and make them yours...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE278088.html]DLsite English[/url]]
